questions.question_text: From this list write down a prime number: 91, 93, 95, 97, 99
$126 is divided into 3 shares in the ratio 1:2:4. Find the value of the largest share.
There are 640 students in a school. The table shows the favourite colour of each of the students (Blue: 120, Green: 2x, Red: 280, Yellow: x). Find the value of x.
Find the relative frequency of students whose favourite colour is red. Give your answer as a fraction in its lowest terms.
Rationalise the denominator and simplify your answer: \frac{10}{5 - \sqrt{5}}
A is the point (3, 7) and B is the point (9, -1). Calculate the length AB.
A regular polygon has 12 sides. Work out the sum of the interior angles of the polygon.
The interior angle of a regular polygon is x°. Find an expression, in terms of x, for the number of sides of this polygon.
Solve the simultaneous equations. You must show all your working. 4x + 3y = -10, 3x - 4y = 5
\frac{2x - 3}{2x + 3} - \frac{2x + 3}{2x - 3} = \frac{ax}{bx^2 - c}. Find the values of a, b and c.

A bag contains 12 discs. There are 2 red discs, 4 blue discs, 5 green discs and 1 yellow disc. A disc is chosen at random and not replaced. A second disc is then chosen at random. Find the probability that both discs are the same colour.
